name: AI Drama Short Film: You Two as the Loyal Husband and His Wife
blurb: An AI drama short film is a tiny movie with AI actors.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 480p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a cinematic short drama in a bright luxury fashion boutique, with the same camera angles, cuts, timing, light and moves, every shot in the same order. The changes: [Image 1] replaces the man in the dark suit (the husband), [Image 2] replaces the blonde woman in the cream suit (the wife), and the shop changes as below.

The husband = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot, also in the close-up, the wide shots and from behind: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), with the clothes from [Image 1]. Never drift back to the face, stubble or dark hair of the man in [Video 1].

The wife = the person in [Image 2], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 2] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), with the clothes from [Image 2]. NO long blonde hair and no cream suit unless [Image 2] shows them.

The saleswoman stays a stranger in a black blazer, never with the face of [Image 1] or [Image 2]. Three different people; never blend their faces.

The racks hold elegant silk dresses, the shelves handbags. The red item in [Video 1] is a folded red silk scarf in every shot. NO baby and no child in any shot: where the blonde woman in [Video 1] holds a baby, the wife holds a small bouquet of white roses.

The shots, second by second:
1. 0-2.7 s: over the shoulders of the wife (left) and the husband (right): the saleswoman holds the red silk scarf up near her collar and gives the husband a slow, flirty smile.
2. 2.7-5.1 s: close-up of the husband: a look at her, a glance aside, then a small smug smile.
3. 5.1-9.6 s: at the counter: she folds the scarf into a plain white paper bag and hands it over with a sweet smile; the husband lifts the bag high and gives her a light, comic bop on the head with it.
4. 9.6-11.8 s: close-up of the saleswoman: she gasps with her mouth open, then presses her lips together, stunned. Not hurt: no injury, no tears.
5. 11.8-15 s: the husband walks to the wife, puts an arm around her, kisses her hair and walks away with her.

One head per person. No text, no logos on the bag or in the shop, no watermark.
